verdicts.reason: A drops the 'Limited Summer Release' eyebrow. Its body copy is oversized and left-aligned, so it competes with the headline. The CTA is a tiny button crammed into the lower left, and the divider and legal text are microscopic and jammed at the right edge. The headline is nearly edge-to-edge, and the layout is unbalanced and chaotic. B keeps the full structure: header with logo, eyebrow, headline, divider, body, a clear CTA, 'Ships late June' and legal text, all centred in the original order. Its flaws are a very dense headline, tiny logo and eyebrow, small legal text, and tight margins at this small size.
